title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Ministry of Justice, and the All China Lawyers Association on Issuing Model Texts of Complaints and Defense Statements for Certain Types of Cases
keywords_en: Issuance and distribution of selected cases
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Ministry of Justice, and the All China Lawyers Association on Issuing Model Forms of Complaint and Defense for Certain Cases

Fa [2025] No. 82

The High People's Courts, the Department (Bureau) of Justice, and the Lawyers Associations of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; the Bureau of Justice and the Lawyers Association of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

In order to thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, implement the people-centered principle, facilitate litigation for the people, respond to the judicial needs of the people with higher quality and more efficient judicial services, and strive to let the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case, on March 4, 2024, the Supreme People's Court, the Ministry of Justice, and the All China Lawyers Association jointly issued the "Model Forms of Civil Complaint and Defense for Certain Cases (Trial)" (Fa [2024] No. 46).

Over the past year or more, through active promotion, publicity, and guidance, lawyers and parties have, through actual use, gained a deeper understanding and recognition of the role of the model forms of complaint and defense in facilitating litigation for the people, facilitating pre-litigation mediation, and promoting the improvement of trial quality and efficiency. At the same time, lawyers, parties, experts and scholars, and judges of basic-level courts have put forward opinions and suggestions on the deficiencies in the process of use, such as enhancing the convenience of use and improving the effectiveness of application.

Accordingly, adhering to a problem-oriented approach, we have fully understood and absorbed the opinions of all parties, and further revised and improved the element categories, content, and format of the model forms. For example, based on the actual work of case filing, we have unified and improved the element categories of "Party Information" in the complaint and defense forms, deleted the columns for "Service Address" and "Electronic Service," optimized the form design, adjusted the font size, so that the parties can understand clearly and use conveniently, reducing the burden on the parties to fill in the forms. We have added blank columns under "Claims," "Defense Matters," and "Facts and Reasons" to facilitate the parties to describe the case or supplement other information as needed, and to fully and comprehensively express their claims. For legal technical terms that are highly specialized and difficult to understand, we have added corresponding explanations and filling instructions. From the concluded cases, we have selected representative complaints and defenses of cases of moderate complexity as examples to facilitate the parties' deeper understanding and reference. In the "List of Evidence," we have provided evidence guidance for some types of cases based on actual causes of action, to facilitate the parties to submit corresponding evidence and improve litigation efficiency. We have added a column for "Willingness to Choose Dispute Resolution Methods" and explained in detail the procedures and advantages of pre-litigation mediation, so as to provide guidance and services for parties to choose pre-litigation mediation to resolve disputes, and also to facilitate the court to fully understand the parties' willingness to mediate, carry out mediation work in a timely manner, and improve the efficiency of dispute resolution.

On this basis, while revising and improving the first batch of 11 types of trial model forms, we have also researched and formulated 56 new types of model forms for common and frequently occurring litigation cases in 9 areas, namely criminal (private prosecution), civil, commercial, intellectual property, maritime, administrative, environmental resources, state compensation, and enforcement. Now, the two batches totaling 67 types of model forms are merged and issued, and will be fully promoted and used from July 14, 2025. The "Model Forms of Civil Complaint and Defense for Certain Cases (Trial)" (Fa [2024] No. 46) issued on March 4, 2024 will be abolished simultaneously. Matters concerning the promotion and application of the model forms are hereby notified as follows:

1. Deepen ideological understanding and fully recognize the important significance of the element-based model forms of complaint and defense. The preparation of complaints and defenses is the first gateway for parties to participate in litigation proceedings, and also a front-end element for achieving high-quality court trials. It directly concerns the protection and realization of the people's right to sue and the quality and efficiency of the people's courts in resolving disputes. The model forms of complaint and defense issued this time adopt a tabular and element-based approach, aiming to enable the people to understand clearly and use conveniently, and to provide standardized and comprehensive litigation guidance for parties to file complaints and defenses. This is a people-oriented measure taken by the people's courts based on the people's judicial needs, facilitating litigation for the people, and improving the efficiency of dispute resolution. People's courts at all levels, together with judicial administrative organs and lawyers associations, should gather work efforts, through in-depth and meticulous publicity, interpretation, training, and clarification, to actively guide and instruct the parties and their agent lawyers to use unified, standardized, element-based, and check-box model forms, so that the people can fully and accurately express their claims, quickly determine the focus of disputes, enhance reasonable expectations of litigation outcomes, promote the substantive, efficient, and one-time resolution of disputes, and effectively implement the principle of "settling disputes with greater emphasis on ending disputes." Work together to implement the people-centered principle and continuously enhance the people's sense of judicial attainment and satisfaction.

2. Adhere to the people-centered principle and firmly establish the work philosophy of facilitating litigation for the people. People's courts at all levels should, in accordance with the overall principle of "active guidance, respect for choice," combine with actual work, actively and steadily advance, and fully do a good job of guiding services for the model forms in all aspects of case filing, trial, enforcement, and pre-litigation mediation. In the litigation service centers, equip sufficient litigation service personnel, introduce intelligent auxiliary tools such as element recognition and backfilling, widely invite lawyers, mediators, legal professional volunteers and other social third parties to participate in guidance services, and gradually achieve further recognition of the model forms by the parties and lawyers. We should adhere to the integrated implementation of the promotion and application of model forms with participation in the construction of comprehensive governance centers and the strengthening of pre-litigation mediation, coordinate the work of inquiries at comprehensive governance centers, guidance of model forms, and notification of pre-litigation mediation, and while guiding the filling of model forms, explain in detail the advantages of pre-litigation mediation, such as saving time, saving costs, and promoting harmony, so as to enhance the effectiveness of substantive dispute resolution. We should strengthen the comprehensive application of model forms in mediation and trial stages, strengthen professional training, further push judges to apply model forms in court trials, and achieve early dispute resolution and high public recognition. People's courts at all levels should fully respect the will of the parties and their agent lawyers, and resolutely prevent the improper refusal to accept cases that should be accepted according to law on the grounds of mandatory application of model forms, and fully protect the parties' exercise of the right to sue according to law. For cases that are not accepted when they should be, each discovered case shall be investigated and dealt with.

3. Adhere to a problem-oriented approach and continuously improve the level of user-friendliness, ease of use, and effectiveness of the model forms. People's courts at all levels, together with judicial administrative organs and lawyers associations, should pay attention to collecting, sorting out, and summarizing the deficiencies and problems found in the process of promoting and applying the model forms, and put forward opinions and suggestions, and promptly report them level by level to the Supreme People's Court, the Ministry of Justice, and the All China Lawyers Association. The parties and their agent lawyers may, through the People's Court Satisfaction Evaluation System, reflect issues and suggestions regarding the design and application of the model forms. The Supreme People's Court will extensively listen to opinions, carefully study and respond, consult with the Ministry of Justice and the All China Lawyers Association to dynamically optimize and improve the model forms in a timely manner, continuously improve the level of user-friendliness, ease of use, and effectiveness of the model forms, better implement the people-centered development concept in the judicial trial process, and promote high-quality development of judicial trials.

May 28, 2025
